summary: Separate the owned GPU host from the cloud preset
description: DEP-04, DEP-05, DEP-10, and DEP-11. gpu-server is the operator's own GPU host: the model is accepted only from the gateway, storage is SQLite, and model_owner is operator. cloud is a provider: public data, private management, Postgres, and model_owner is provider. Both are remote URL deployments, like each other, and unlike the developer workstation. The high-water mark is stored on a volume path. Reporting may be down.
scope: gpu-server and cloud differ by ownership, public bind, and storage
The high-water file round-trips and gateway_requires_reporting is false
acceptanceCriteria: gpu-server has model_accepts gateway-only, tls true, storage sqlite, and model_owner operator. cloud has data_host 0.0.0.0, management_host 127.0.0.1, management_public false, tls true, storage postgres, and model_owner provider. save_high_water then load_high_water returns the timestamp. gateway_requires_reporting is false. DEP-04 DEP-05 DEP-10 DEP-11.
constraints: Do not mark the cloud management plane public.
Do not set gpu-server model_owner to provider or to the developer workstation.
Do not require reporting to be up before the gateway starts.
Do not store prompts in the high-water file.
